final.result:
**Not proven.** Our earlier evaluation doesn't cover your case.

- **What we tested before** (Ostrich 0.9, March 2026, project wiki): 4.1x compression, but only on text log files under 1 MB, on a single core.
- **What the archives are** (`telemetry-archives.md`): protobuf-encoded binary frames, 40–300 MB per file.

Binary payloads and files over 1 MB were never tested, so the 4.1x figure doesn't carry over. Protobuf data is already compact, so text-log ratios are unlikely to hold. Before deciding, I'd benchmark Ostrich against zstd on a few real nightly archives, comparing compression ratio, speed and memory use.
